data.title: All Saints School robotics teams win Innovate Award at premier event
data.description: ALPENA — After a successful 2025-2026 robotics season, the All Saints Holy Gears were one of 48 teams from across the world invited to the Canadian Rockies Premier Event, where they were the winners of the Innovate Award. The Holy Gears won several awards throughout their season, including the second place Inspire Award at the […]
